metadata.description: 18-storey Grade-A office tower, 26,000 m², 5-day occupancy with weekend setback.
600-bed teaching hospital, 24/7 operation, high baseload and strict comfort requirements.
Multi-block research campus with PV on-site and aggressive load-shifting potential.
Colocation data centre with a flat critical baseload and large cooling demand.
Technology park in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. Outdoor conditions are the real Open-Meteo 2024 archive and the load is calibrated to CEA Tamil Nadu daily demand.
